asked.item: Does personal Facebook login use one of the 20 accounts?
Do not want to pay for the personal login

verdict.reason: The pages state that the personal Facebook login does not count toward the account limit and each connected Page counts as one.

steps.text: The personal Facebook login does not count toward your plan's connected-account limit.
Each Facebook Page you connect counts as one account.
You must keep the personal Facebook login connected, because disconnecting it removes every Page connected through it.
